rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things that can continue long term without harming the environment or exhausting resources.

example.english: This development model has to be sustainable before it can continue in the long run.
example.traditional: 呢個發展模式要做到可持續，先可以行得長遠。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 faat3 zin2 mou4 sik1 jiu3 zou6 dou3 ho2 ci4 zuk6 sin1 ho2 ji5 haang4 dak1 coeng4 jyun5

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being environmentally friendly rather than on lasting indefinitely.

example.english: This laundry detergent uses simple, sustainable packaging, so people can buy it with peace of mind.
example.traditional: 呢款洗衣液用簡約又環保嘅包裝，令人買得放心。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 sai2 ji1 jik6 jung6 gaan2 joek3 jau6 waan4 bou2 ge3 baau1 zong1 ling6 jan4 maai5 dak1 fong3 sam1

rows.note: Use this for renewable resources, such as energy or materials that can naturally be replenished.

example.english: Solar power is a sustainable energy source, so we do not need to worry about running out.
example.traditional: 太陽能係一種可再生能源，唔使擔心用完。
example.jyutping: taai3 joeng4 nang4 hai6 jat1 zung2 ho2 zoi3 sang1 nang4 jyun4 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 jung6 jyun4
